message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Backup for Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Azure Backup for Azure Cosmos DB is now generally available. Vaulted backup protects your Azure Cosmos DB accounts with immutable, long-term backups stored in a logically air-gapped backup vault, isolated from your production environment. It complements native continuous backups, which provide up to 35 days of operational recovery, by adding retention of up to 10 years for compliance, audit and ransomware recovery. 

With vaulted backup you get WORM immutability, soft delete, multi-user authorization, Azure RBAC and encryption with customer-managed keys, all managed centrally alongside your other Azure Backup workloads. 

New since public preview: 

  • Daily incremental backups with a weekly full backup, for a 1-day RPO 
  • Support for accounts with up to 2,500 physical partitions (about 125 TB) 
  • Cross-region restore to the Azure paired region, in addition to cross-subscription restore 
  • Availability in all Azure public cloud regions 
  • Auto-heal retries of scheduled backups that fail because of transient issues 

Supported for NoSQL and MongoDB (RU-based) accounts with continuous backup enabled. Get started today from Resiliency in the Azure portal or with the Azure CLI.
